name: io.github.taltal-beep/mcp-server-celery
description: Read-only Celery debugging: workers, queue depths and stuck-task diagnosis.

environmentVariables.name: CELERY_BROKER_URL
environmentVariables.description: Broker URL, e.g. redis://localhost:6379/0 or amqp://user:pass@host:5672//

environmentVariables.name: CELERY_RESULT_BACKEND
environmentVariables.description: Result backend URL, needed for task_status

environmentVariables.name: CELERY_APP
environmentVariables.description: Import path of your Celery app (e.g. proj.celery:app) to pick up its queues and routes

environmentVariables.name: CELERY_INSPECT_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Seconds to wait for worker replies (default 1.0)
